periods.analysis: Public Health staff helped 212 households enroll in food assistance in Q1.
periods.recommendations: Open an enrollment desk at a library branch.

periods.analysis: Enrollments rose from 212 to 287 after the Harbor Creek library desk opened.
periods.recommendations: Staff enrollment tables at farmers markets.

periods.analysis: Enrollments rose to 366 in Q3, with the two farmers market tables and the Harbor Creek library desk producing about half of them.
periods.recommendations: Add a screener at school registration and track how many enrolled households stay enrolled at 90 days.
